decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the erection of a rear roof extension to enlarge the existing dormer, incorporating the installation of one front roof light to the existing house, as shown on drawing number KGS/GUN/279P2/1A, received 20 March 2007, by reason of its size, position and appearance, would be compatible with the scale and form of the original building and would maintain the amenity of neighbouring properties and is considered to preserve the appearance and character of Gunnersbury Park Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations, and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - The roof light shall be installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
description: Erection of a rear roof extension to enlarge the existing dormer, incorporating the installation of one front roof light to the existing house
